title: Microsoft joins AI cost-cutting trend by relying more on its own models

thread_text:

Microsoft dropped external models and built smaller ones. Internal task performance actually went up.

2. Cheaper, not weaker.

3. Same provider, lower bill.

You don't have to switch vendors to cut AI spend. Just demand first-party model trials.

Smaller models beat larger ones on company-specific tasks. Size isn't everything in AI.
